narrative_alignment_note: Published winner's own OOS-Sharpe-by-lead curve (foreground, INDPRO) peaks at L4; deployed lead L4 = 1.23. Grey bars: best-of-any-signal envelope on the same native grid (envelope >= winner curve at every lead). Buy-and-hold SPY = 0.90. On the tournament's own grid the winner's lead L4 is at the top of a NEARLY FLAT envelope (leads differ by <0.10 Sharpe) — no lead is decisively best. It is not the off-peak dip a different (exploratory) sweep grid suggested, but the flat profile means the lead choice is weakly identified, consistent with this pair's low-confidence framing.
